name: Condenser 2
source: Neustroeva A. A., master thesis NSU 2021, Table 2 (photomask topology for MIR 15-35 keV objectives/condensers) [47]
N_definition: N = number of elements focusing in ONE transverse direction; the full set has 2N single linear elements alternating X/Y
d_note: central web not given in Table 2; reconstructed from p = d + A^2/(4R) -> 10 um (also stated for condenser 2 in Neustroeva 2019, sec. 5.2). Adjustable.
height_note: 0 = automatic (4 x half aperture); the structure height of the real lenses is not given in the sources
reference_note: Table 2 focal lengths FL (cm) by photon energy (keV); they coincide with the thin-lens value R/(2 N delta(E)), delta(E) from formula (1.7.4).
data_note: With d = 10 um, d + A^2/(4R) = 1555.34 um vs p = 1555 um: parabolic aperture 2 sqrt(R(p-d)) = 608.93 um (table 609 um).
